career_overview.short_description: Write software that interacts with electronic devices. Learn the basics of C, microcontrollers, inputs and timing through simulations or simple boards.
responsibilities: Assess goals and constraints relevant to embedded systems developer work
Apply appropriate tools and methods to a bounded task
representative_work: A simulated or optional board-based sensor-and-output project.

roadmap.title: Embedded Systems Developer: beginner foundations and starter project
roadmap.intended_learner: Motivated beginner; basic computer literacy assumed, with no prior professional experience.
roadmap.starting_requirements: Computer, internet access, text editor and browser. Most tasks use free software or simulation; specialist equipment, accounts and costs are flagged for review when applicable.
roadmap.final_outcome: A simulated or optional board-based sensor-and-output project.
